title: Jappeere Jaagorgal Jahnde e nder sahaa gooto
intro: Limre laamu mawnde laamiima laamu alɗungu barkinaaɗo e jawdi ɓurndi heewde. Nde caɗeele ɗe cikkataa ummii, oo laamɗo fotnoo ko ñaaweede wonaa kaafaaje kono ko hakkille e goonɗinal. Ko feeñi heen koo, maa artu gila e pinndi doole aduna haa e waylo-waylo ɓernde luggiɗngo.
clues: Mi laamiima laamu barkinaaɗo e jawdi e wellitaare ɓurnde miijaade
Miin ko mi laamɗo doole keɓɗo ɓataake cuusal ɗaɓɓoowo ɗooftaare
Tedduɓe am ina wasiyoo mi so tawii miɗo haɓa walla miɗo jokkondira e oo laamɗo woɗɗuɗo
Mi ummii e dokke mawɗe ngam hawrude e oo laamɗo woɗɗuɗo miin e hoore am
Jappeere am laamɗo ndee addaama e leydi ngoɗndi e nder ɓuuɓri gite, hade am hootde
Nde naatirmi e galle laamorɗo mo leydi mum ina ɓuuɓi no gilaasi nii, mi haalanii ɗooftaare am e Alla

Eggugol e nder jarne weltaare haa abada

arabic: فَلَمَّا جَآءَتْ قِيلَ أَهَـٰكَذَا عَرْشُكِ ۖ قَالَتْ كَأَنَّهُۥ هُوَ ۚ وَأُوتِينَا ٱلْعِلْمَ مِن قَبْلِهَا وَكُنَّا مُسْلِمِينَ
verse: So when she arrived, it was said [to her], "Is your throne like this?" She said, "[It is] as though it was it." [Solomon said], "And we were given knowledge before her, and we have been Muslims [in submission to Allāh]. (27:42)
